fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-02-05 states that Senthil Rajan, aged 25, could not be traced after leaving home for a temple visit; the last sighting was near Nallur Colony College Road in Madurai, on 2025-02-05 at roughly 07:15. The complaint was lodged by Nandhini Sekar (9000000014), a family member of Senthil Rajan, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000019. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage, photographs and social media screenshots.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: CCTV footage; Photograph; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person reportedly left the residence and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, morning, photograph, CCTV, college road
